class pyQt5.MainWindow[source]

Bases: QMainWindow

Main window of the School Management System built with PyQt5.

Provides forms for adding/updating students, instructors, and courses, along with search/filtering, JSON import/export, CSV export, database backup, and enrollment/assignment actions.

class pyQt5.Person(name: str, age: int, email: str)[source]

Bases: object

Base class representing a person with name, age, and email.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Full name of the person.

  • age (int) – Age of the person; must be a non-negative integer.

  • email (str) – Email address in the format name@example.com.

Raises:

ValueError – If age is negative or not an int, or if email is not in a valid format.
